title: Do you really need space-grade components?
summary: Everspin's Sean Dougherty discusses space-grade components, aerospace memory selection and how MRAM fits into satellite and space system design in SpaceNews.
body_markdown:
In a SpaceNews op-ed, Everspin Technologies’ Sean Dougherty examines whether satellite and aerospace systems always require space-grade components or whether commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) technologies can meet mission-specific requirements. The article explores key considerations in selecting reliable memory for space applications, including radiation tolerance, and the potential role of magnetoresistive RAM (MRAM) in satellite electronics.


[Read the full article: Do you really need space-grade components? - SpaceNews](https://spacenews.com/do-you-really-need-space-grade-components/)
